text:
**Meridian planning (3–10 Nov)**

**Final values:** checkout and tenant timeout_s 70; pricing timeout_s 120; backup 110; indexer 55; shipping timeout_s 30, ttl_s 450; export ttl_s 480; media ttl_s 600; archive batch_size 900; ledger max_workers 16; audit max_workers 8; inventory queue_depth 490; billing queue_depth 270; pricing queue_depth 250; reports retry_limit 8.

**Hard rules:** No dependency path from reports to notify, quota to gateway, or archive to sync. indexer must not depend on auth, even indirectly. indexer and shipping go on separate workers. alerts and archive never share a worker.

**Ownership:** tenant and indexer on alpha; search and webhooks on gamma; profile on delta; billing on beta; reports and notify on delta.

**Rollout order:** gateway before cache; audit before sync; alerts before webhooks; billing before tenant.

**Unresolved:** billing and media must share a worker, but audit keeps backup and media apart.
